scan_interval.description: How often (in seconds) to scrape each SNMP target.

timeout.description: Maximum time (in seconds) to wait for a response from an SNMP device.

retries.description: Number of times to retry a failed SNMP request before marking it as failed.

modules.description: List of SNMP module configurations defining how to poll different device types.

auth_protocol.description: Authentication protocol for SNMPv3 (MD5, SHA, etc.).

priv_protocol.description: Privacy (encryption) protocol for SNMPv3 (DES, AES, etc.).

auth_name.description: Username for SNMPv3 authentication (required if auth_level includes auth).

priv_name.description: Username for SNMPv3 privacy (required if auth_level is 'authPriv').

mibs.description: List of MIB names or paths to load (e.g., 'IF-MIB', 'UCD-SNMP-MIB').

walk.description: List of root OIDs to walk for metrics (e.g., '1.3.6.1.2.1', '1.3.6.1.4.1.2021').
